source: Inspired by assets/template/Ascendion-Data Practice-Capability Deck_final.pptx slides 19 ('Next Steps') and 25 ('Thank You'), and assets/template/Business Process Agentification (Session 4).pptx slide 26 ('Thank you'). The originals are minimal placeholder closes; this example richens the pattern with three numbered next-step rows so the slide actually advances a sale or hand-off.
intent: End the deck with a claim-style call-to-action and exactly three concrete next-step actions. Use to close pitch decks, executive briefings, or proposal decks — never as a generic 'Thank You' slide (the headline should advance work, not say goodbye).
invariants: exactly 3 numbered next-step rows in vertical order
each row: numeric block (01/02/03 in title type style on accent_1 fill) + bold subtitle label + body description
header bar with kicker 'Next steps' (or similar action label) + claim-style title above the rows
thin accent stripe along the bottom of the body region (accent_2)
no metrics, no images, no quote — pure action items
variables: headline (must be a claim with a verb — 'Lock the first 30 days', 'Sign the SOW this week')
kicker label ('Next steps', 'What we need from you', 'How to start')
row count fixed at 3 (cap from archetype; do not exceed)
row body text (8-15 words, single sentence)
numeric block accent color (default accent_1; change for tone)
